AGENDA
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  SPECIAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEETING
  November 8, 2022 ~ 4:00 P.M.

Meeting Location: Mary Rodriguez Senior Center, Senior Conference Room, 21815 Pioneer Blvd.,
Hawaiian Gardens, CA 90716.

Please Note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the Americans with
Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please contact the Recreation and Community
Services Department at (562) 420-2641, at least one business day prior to the meeting so that we may
accommodate you.

THE MEETING WILL BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC WITH LIMITED SEATING CAPACITY TO ALLOW
FOR SOCIAL DISTANCING. ALL PERSONS WHO ATTEND THIS MEETING ARE STRONGLY
RECOMMENDED TO WEAR A FACE MASK/FACE SHIELD AT ALL TIMES AND PRACTICE SOCIAL
DISTANCING.

PLEASE NOTE THAT IN LIGHT OF AB 361, THE SPECIAL EVENTS COMMITTEE MEETING COULD
BE CONDUCTED AS A HYBRID VIRTUAL MEETING AND IN PERSON MEETING. HOWEVER, DUE
TO LIMITED CITY STAFF AND CITY OFFICIALS NECESSARY TO CONDUCT THIS COMMITTEE
MEETING AND THE LOW PUBLIC TURNOUT FOR THIS COMMITTEE MEETING, THIS MEETING
WILL BE CONDUCTED SOLELY IN PERSON AND IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPLICABLE SOCIAL
DISTANCING AND PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY GUIDELINES.

  A. ROLL CALL OF COMMITTEE MEMBERS

  •  Juan Serrano, Recreation Supervisor
  •  Victor Farfan, Councilmember
  •  Jesse Alvarado, Councilmember

  B. PUBLIC COMMENTS

  This is the time reserved for those in the audience to address the Special Events Committee
  regarding any subject. (Time Limit: Maximum of three (3) minutes per speaker; total time
  allocated is 10 minutes.)

  C. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  1. Discussion on City of Hawaiian Gardens Christmas Winter Wonderland.

  D. NEW BUSINESS

  E. ORAL COMMITTEE REPORTS

  F. ADJOURNMENT

  Adjourn to the next Special Events Committee meeting, to be determined.
